title: Identifiers
description: Identifier formats shared by all contracts. Runtime instance ids are '<prefix>_<1-64 alphanumerics>' (ADR-0007); the part after the prefix is opaque (ULID, UUID hex, etc. are all valid). Definition ids are pack-internal and stable for a given definition; they are fully qualified by pack_id + pack_version.

lab_instance_id.description: LabInstance id. A lab reset creates a new one.

memo_id.description: Learning memo id. One memo per highlight thread (docs/briefs/highlight-memo-contract.md).

definition_id.description: Pack-internal Definition id (activity, environment, evaluator, visualization, content, prompt), e.g. 'diagnose-dns-resolver-failure-v1'.

skill_id.description: Skill id, e.g. 'network.dns.resolution'. Stable across pack versions, never reused (ADR-0007).

adapter_item_id.description: Id of a check / fixture / tool registered in a domain adapter, e.g. 'dns.resolver_answers'.

token.description: Short lowercase symbolic value (mode, pane, dimension, role).

local_ref.description: Opaque in-document reference without whitespace (step id, anchor).

idempotency_key.description: Producer-chosen key; a resend with the same key returns the existing event (ADR-0008). Unique across the event store, so producers namespace it.

correlation_id.description: Groups related events (one attempt, one chat round trip). May reuse an existing id such as an attempt_id.

event_uuid.description: v0.2 event id (envelope v2 'id'): a client-generated UUID in canonical lowercase form, unique across the event store; a resend with the same id is the same event. Kept apart from the v0.1 'evt_' event_id until the v0.1 contracts are removed.

doc_id.description: v0.2 text doc id. Pack-authored name or a lowercase UUID for a generated doc (both match definition_id).

block_id.description: v0.2 text block id, assigned once when the block is finalized. Pack-authored name or a lowercase UUID.

item_id.description: v0.2 drill item id. Pack-authored name or a lowercase UUID for a generated item.
